library_preparation_preflight.summary: No extra dependency, Docker image, or system property is required; the failure is a 3.0-to-4.0 API migration.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Update the generated test for the 4.0 API. Prefer the public NettyBoltConnectionProviderFactory and BoltConnectionProvider URI-based connect API; do not copy the 3.0 direct-provider test unchanged. Use a null SecurityPlan for the existing non-TLS loopback fake server, and replace removed RoutingContext, DatabaseNameUtil, and SecurityPlans.unencrypted usages. No external Neo4j server is needed.
risks: 4.0.0 exports only NettyBoltConnectionProviderFactory publicly; provider and BootstrapFactory implementation classes moved under an internal package. [module descriptor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neo4j/bolt-connection-java/4.0.0/neo4j-bolt-connection-netty/src/main/java/module-info.java)

The artifact declares Netty and neo4j-bolt-connection as production dependencies; its test-values dependency is test-scoped upstream and is not required for the generated scaffold. [POM](https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/neo4j/bolt/neo4j-bolt-connection-netty/4.0.0/neo4j-bolt-connection-netty-4.0.0.pom)
This is an internal module intended for Neo4j drivers, so live Neo4j integration would be separate coverage. [upstream README](https://github.com/neo4j/bolt-connection-java/tree/4.0.0)
